The modifier is consumed by the live hit calculation (critical_parameters joins buff_stat("crit_damage_bonus") into the additive crit-damage zone per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 3), so the crit-zone effect is executed end to end through the real cast path. T5 hand-derived (not asserted by code): per-stack 0.20 = 1/5, 4-stack cap = 4/5 additive.

name: Silent Garden

passive_description.localized: Increases CRIT DMG by <lv>{1}</> for <lv>{0}</>s when the wearer's HP is reduced without taking damage, up to <lv>4</> stacks. Unlocks Arc: Silent Garden. (Arc clauses out of scope)

tested_hypotheses: Only actions carrying the content-owned ntesim.trigger.hp_cost tag grant the buff; untagged actions grant nothing.

HP reduction without taking damage is not modeled by the engine, so the tag is an explicit scenario-level declaration of the trigger, never a silent zero and never an invented native trigger; return condition: replace the tag check when the engine models HP-cost events natively.
Each trigger adds one stack up to a cap of 4 on a single BuffManager instance and resets the 5s duration (BuffManager RefreshPolicy::Reset, max_stacks 4, DecayPolicy::AllAtOnce).
A trigger at the 4-stack cap refreshes the duration without adding a fifth stack.
The buff expires after the duration and contributes nothing once expired; a tagged cast after expiry grants a fresh single-stack buff.
The buff is wearer-only (BuffRecipient::SelfActor): the bonus does not spill onto a teammate actor.
The per-stack crit damage bonus joins the additive critical-damage zone: two stacks at T1 give exactly 31/25; four stacks at T1 give exactly 12/25 (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT sections 1 and 3).
The staged crit_damage_bonus modifier is consumed by the live hit path (critical_parameters), so the projection's runtime_execution_validated=true is verified, not aspirational.
The +12%/+14%/+16%/+18%/+20% values and 5s duration are bound from CT_ForkBuff through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent unit checks.

The Arc: Silent Garden clauses (buff_tingyuan_HPreduce, buff_tingyuan_CD2, GE_Fork_serenity_Skill1_Damage1, GE_Fork_serenity_Skill2_Damage) are validated as frozen shape but never projected or consumed.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
